magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'mobi' prefix of the 8-byte mobile-system identifier stored at the head of each voted copy

fields.name: copy0_mobile_id
fields.description: Copy 0 of the 8-byte mobile-system identifier (ASCII 'mobile21'); voted per byte against copies 1-2 and required byte-exact
fields.evidence: FUN_08054918 reads 0x1E bytes from SRAM 0x0E000000 into staging buffer *_DAT_08054994, votes bytes with FUN_080547cc/FUN_08054748 across copies at +0/+10/+20, then compares all 8 payload bytes against the expected value at iRam0805499c; FUN_0805486c provisions the 8 bytes from ROM defaults at _DAT_08054914.

fields.name: copy0_xor_word
fields.description: Copy 0 trailing integrity word: XOR of the four little-endian u16 halves of copy 0 payload (baseline 0x5251); full 10-byte record must XOR to zero
fields.evidence: FUN_0805486c computes FUN_08054824(*_DAT_0805490c, 8) and stores the u16 at staging-buffer+8, then writes the 10-byte record to SRAM 0x0E000000 via FUN_0809390c; load path FUN_08054918 accepts the record only if FUN_08054844 over 10 bytes reports XOR==0.

fields.name: copy1_mobile_id
fields.description: Copy 1 of the 8-byte mobile-system identifier (ASCII 'mobile21'); per-byte median voter input for offsets 0-7
fields.evidence: FUN_08054918 votes SRAM bytes at 0x0E00000A against copies at 0x0E000000/+20 via FUN_080547cc (per-byte median FUN_08054748); rewrite path FUN_0805486c stores the identical 8-byte ROM default (from _DAT_08054914) at SRAM 0x0E00000A.

fields.name: copy1_xor_word
fields.description: Copy 1 trailing integrity word: XOR of the four little-endian u16 halves of copy 1 payload (baseline 0x5251)
fields.evidence: FUN_0805486c stores FUN_08054824 checksum output at staging-buffer+8 and writes the 10-byte record to SRAM 0x0E00000A via FUN_0809390c; FUN_08054918 validates copy 1 through the same FUN_08054844 XOR==0 check over its 10 bytes.

fields.name: copy2_mobile_id
fields.description: Copy 2 of the 8-byte mobile-system identifier (ASCII 'mobile21'); per-byte median voter input for offsets 0-7
fields.evidence: FUN_08054918 votes SRAM bytes at 0x0E000014 against copies at 0x0E000000/+10 via FUN_080547cc (per-byte median FUN_08054748); rewrite path FUN_0805486c stores the identical 8-byte ROM default (from _DAT_08054914) at SRAM 0x0E000014.

fields.name: copy2_xor_word
fields.description: Copy 2 trailing integrity word: XOR of the four little-endian u16 halves of copy 2 payload (baseline 0x5251)
fields.evidence: FUN_0805486c stores FUN_08054824 checksum output at staging-buffer+8 and writes the 10-byte record to SRAM 0x0E000014 via FUN_0809390c; FUN_08054918 validates copy 2 through the same FUN_08054844 XOR==0 check over its 10 bytes.
